description: Aziz Abdul Aziz publishes twelve HOMER Pro 3.18.4 project files for an island-microgrid sizing study. Zenodo offers the project-file ZIP under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. The deposit says files 01–10 contain reported configurations and sensitivity grids for battery state-of-charge floors and fuel-price thresholds; files 11–12 are superseded versions kept to document a wind-cost correction. Stored results were removed, so users must recalculate each case in HOMER Pro. The projects can support microgrid capacity and fuel-cost sensitivity comparisons. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these case models. A limitation is that HOMER Pro is a separate software dependency with its own access terms, and the public page gives no inventory of the internal load or resource time series. The ZIP was not downloaded, so model settings, reported numbers and correction history were not independently checked.
